text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly breathe a sigh of relief with 
this. Simply placing will never be enough 
to satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What I desire is a flawless victory. 
Otherwise... I cannot accept myself.
choice_data_list:
If it's McQueen, she can make it to the 
top!
Let's build up more real ability.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So you have high hopes for me. Yes, I 
shall certainly rise to the top.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am a Mejiro Umamusume. I am destined for 
flawless victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I must hone my skills 
even further!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am well aware. At this rate, I will 
not be able to fulfill my duty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So Trainer-san, please train me even 
harder."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And together, let us seize a flawless 
victory!
